notes: BETA 2.29.93. Free Edge voice works again in Europe (Microsoft moved its voice server on 10 October). NEW crashes and damage: after a hit the engineer reacts, and a few seconds later gives a damage check with advice (box or keep going); ask 'any damage?' or 'how is the car?'. LMU/rF2 damage is read for the first time (dents, lost parts, flat or lost wheels, overheating), plus AMS2, ACC and F1. Race end now comes when YOU cross the line, not when the leader does (you get a last-lap call instead). Korean engineer voice. Real on-track gaps in F1, iRacing, AMS2 and ACC (no more false 'clear air'). The spotter uses the same voice as the engineer. Custom AI endpoint (any OpenAI-compatible base URL: OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio...) and custom TTS server. iRacing: no more 'tyres too hot' calls (iRacing only measures tyres in the pits), race length and laps-to-go work. LMU qualifying: no cars from the garage. Restart detection only in races (going to the garage in practice no longer wipes your laps). 'Go go go' at the green flag, not on the formation lap. Lower FPS drop while the engineer listens, clear message for OpenAI accounts without credit. Not tested with the real games yet - please report on Discord, especially the damage calls in LMU.
